about.title: An old craft, new standards
about.lead: The Chimney Sweeps Association of Moldova (ASFOCMD) brings together specialists in sweeping and inspecting chimneys, promoting fire safety and the professionalisation of the sweep's craft.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.p1: We work so that every home in Moldova heated by a stove, fireplace or boiler has a safe chimney, checked by a certified specialist. A clean chimney means fewer fires, fewer carbon monoxide poisonings and more efficient heat.
mission.p2: The association certifies craftsmen, runs European-standard training and represents the guild in dialogue with the authorities and with European partners.

veuko.title: Member of the European federation VEUKO
veuko.p: ASFOCMD is a member of VEUKO, the European federation of master chimney sweeps, alongside national associations from more than twenty countries. Membership gives us access to standards, training materials and exchange of experience at European level.

statute.title: The association's statute
statute.p: The ASFOCMD statute sets out the association's purpose, the rights and obligations of members, and how the association is organised.
aims: represent, promote, support and protect the economic, technical and legal interests of its members in relations with public authorities, governmental and non-governmental organisations, natural or legal persons and other authorities; and to foster a favourable image of ASFOCMD and its members nationally and internationally;

create the organisational framework for members to carry out the concepts, measures and actions that lead to developing, refining and increasing the contribution of the association's specialists to improving the design, installation, operation, maintenance and repair of chimneys, ventilation systems, stoves and fireplaces in the Republic of Moldova;

provide members with useful information to facilitate relations among themselves and with other organisations, offer consultancy and assistance in the field, and promote fair competition in economic activity and in the relations between members, ensuring equal conditions for each;
represent its members in international professional organisations.

training.title: European-standard training
training.lead: We run hands-on courses for chimney sweeps, stove builders and installers — from the basics of the craft to inspecting modern heating systems.

intro.title: How it works
intro.p: Sessions combine theory with practical work on mock-ups and real installations, guided by trainers with international experience. Groups are small, and participants take a practical test at the end.
